$comment: Shared CALM Studio pattern catalog. Architects: drop a pattern .json into this folder and add an entry below. `id` is stable; `name`/`description` drive the picker card; `category` groups patterns into tabs; `tags` are display pills. `file` is the filename in this folder. No app rebuild required for a deployed instance — these are static assets.

patterns.name: Permissive Baseline
patterns.description: Only requires top-level nodes and relationships arrays. Any well-formed CALM 1.2 architecture passes.

patterns.name: Must Have a Database
patterns.description: Requires at least one node of node-type 'database'. A non-positional structural rule via JSON Schema 'contains'.

patterns.name: Strict Public Web Entry
patterns.description: The first node must be a webclient with unique-id 'public-web'. Showcases violations, node badges, and the source filter.
